candidates.change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 5 ether so calls with 5 ether succeed and update state/withdrawal behavior.
Remove the timestamp monotonicity check so fallback can be called multiple times in same block and pastBlockTime becomes potentially unchanged relative to original behavior.
Update pastBlockTime using block.number instead of block.timestamp so stored value differs and future timestamp comparisons would behave differently.
Change payout condition to trigger when block.number % 15 != 0 so withdrawal occurs on different blocks.
Insert an immediate refund of msg.value before updating pastBlockTime so caller gets refunded and contract balance doesn't grow.
Change the transfer target from msg.sender to tx.origin so withdrawal goes to the original EOA rather than to the immediate caller.
